_source: The formats a repo's self-merge judge reads (a scheduled workflow that merges a one-way PR outside the brake's core after the window), copied from its source and tests. The plugin writes the panel comment and the freeze issue, and reads the notice; a change here follows the judge, never the other way.
notice_sample:
<!-- brake-self-merge-notice -->
@owner self-merge window: #77 (https://github.com/o/r/pull/77) · one-way money
merges itself at 2026-11-07T10:00Z or later unless someone adds the label `veto` with a comment `veto: <name> · <reason>`.
head: `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
run: 4242
freeze_open_means_frozen: any open issue (not a pull request) with the freeze label
